Erzeugt UBL-2.1-Rechnungen nach Peppol B: Builds UBL 2.1 invoices under Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, checks them against the official EN 16931 rule set, resolves receivers via SML and SMP, hands completed WooCommerce order invoices to a configured KoSIT validator and Phase4 service, verifies signed AS4 receipts, and shows buyers the stored status. No built-in AS4 transport: Phase4 handles transmission.
